title: Customized Training
description: On-chain Academy delivers world-class education programs designed to help enterprises, public officials, and investors understand and harness the On-chain Economy. Through structured On-chain Masterclass, the series of New Finance workshops, and the On-chain Business Training, we equip participants with the knowledge and tools to adopt blockchain technologies, design on-chain business models, and stay ahead in the digital economy.
bodyHtml:
On-chain Masterclass

The On-chain Masterclass is a curated executive learning program co-organized by On-chain Academy and the Center for Innovation and Transformation (CIT), tailored for leaders driving the future of Vietnam’s International Financial Center (IFC). Over two intensive days, this masterclass equips high-level government officials, researchers, and business executives with the strategic knowledge and practical insights needed to navigate the emerging world of blockchain technology, digital assets, and the On-chain Economy.

This is not a technical training — it is a master-level exploration of how decentralized technologies are reshaping financial systems, policy frameworks, and global economic models. Participants will gain a deep understanding of the real-world implications of blockchain and crypto assets in the context of regulatory innovation, sandbox design, and cross-sector integration. The program bridges international best practices with Vietnam’s local development agenda, supporting both public governance and private-sector transformation.

By bringing together pioneers from the public and private sectors, the On-chain Masterclass fosters a shared foundation for collaboration, policy co-creation, and long-term strategy. Whether you are contributing to legal frameworks or preparing your business for digital asset integration, this program offers the clarity, context, and connections to lead with confidence in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

On-chain Business Training

Our On-chain Business Training is designed exclusively for enterprise leaders and executives, providing a strategic understanding of blockchain technology and the rapidly evolving On-chain Economy. Through a structured curriculum across Foundation, Advanced, and Professional levels, participants will gain in-depth knowledge of On-chain Products, On-chain Finance, and On-chain Governance. Each module combines real-world business cases with actionable frameworks, empowering enterprises to drive innovation, enhance operational efficiency, and explore new value creation models.

Led by seasoned industry practitioners, the program goes beyond technical theory to tackle real business challenges and opportunities in the digital economy. Whether you're exploring new business models, streamlining operations, or positioning your company for long-term growth, this training will equip you with the tools and insights needed to lead with confidence in the On-chain era. Join us to unlock the future of enterprise—decentralized, efficient, and built for impact.

New Finance Workshop

As Vietnam takes bold steps toward establishing an International Financial Center (IFC), this workshop brings together government leaders, industry experts, and top business executives to explore how on-chain assets and on-chain technologies are reshaping the financial and economic landscape. Participants will gain strategic insights into Vietnam’s legal and policy framework for digital finance, and how it opens unprecedented opportunities for Vietnamese enterprises to access global capital and adopt next-generation business models.

Through keynote speeches, deep-dive presentations, and a high-level panel discussion, the workshop offers a practical roadmap for businesses to engage in the on-chain economy. From tokenizing real-world assets to implementing programmable, transparent financial operations, this event is designed to equip decision-makers with the knowledge and tools to lead Vietnam’s transition into a digital, capital-efficient, and globally integrated economy.

title: Research & Development
description: Our R&D arm explores the forefront of blockchain and on-chain innovations, translating cutting-edge research into practical applications for Vietnam and beyond. By collaborating with enterprises, policymakers, and global partners, we provide insights, pilot projects, and whitepapers that shape the future of the On-chain Economy. From policy frameworks to business model innovation, our R&D ensures that On-chain Academy remains a thought leader and catalyst for sustainable growth.
bodyHtml:
At On-chain Academy, our R&D initiatives are designed to bridge the gap between cutting-edge blockchain innovation and real-world application. We collaborate closely with regulators, government agencies, and research institutions to conduct scientific studies and pilot projects that explore the foundations of the On-chain Economy. This ensures that our work not only advances knowledge but also directly contributes to Vietnam’s economic transformation.

Our research focuses on developing and refining policy frameworks that enable sustainable growth of on-chain activities. By providing evidence-based insights and actionable recommendations, we support policymakers in creating a legal environment that fosters innovation while maintaining transparency and security. This approach empowers enterprises, investors, and regulators to navigate the On-chain Economy with confidence.

In addition, we drive R&D projects that demonstrate practical models of on-chain adoption across industries. From tokenized assets to decentralized finance applications, our research outputs serve as blueprints for enterprises and government bodies to experiment, validate, and implement new solutions. Through this, On-chain Academy positions itself as a trusted partner in shaping both policy and practice for the future of Vietnam’s On-chain Economy.

title: On-chain Hub
description: On-chain Hub is an initiative by On-chain Academy to position Vietnam as a rising leader in the global on-chain economy. It serves a dual purpose: showcasing Vietnam’s Web3 capabilities to the world, while attracting global capital, talent, and technology to scale up Vietnam’s on-chain ecosystem.
bodyHtml:
1. The Vietnam House – Showcasing Vietnam Web3 to the World

The Vietnam House is a flagship initiative under On-chain Hub, designed to present Vietnam’s Web3 talent, innovation, and projects on global stages such as Token2049 and other leading international blockchain events.

  • Objective: To position Vietnam as a hub for Web3 innovation by showcasing homegrown startups, products, and talent to investors, builders, and policymakers worldwide.

  • Format: A dedicated exhibition and networking pavilion branded as “The Vietnam House,” representing Vietnam’s Web3 ecosystem at major events.

  • Impact:

    • Elevates Vietnam’s visibility in the global Web3 map.

    • Opens new opportunities for collaboration, investment, and market expansion.

    • Builds international recognition for Vietnamese founders and projects.

2. Fintech Hub IFC Ho Chi Minh City

The Fintech Hub, located within Ho Chi Minh City’s International Financial Center (IFC), functions as an open sandbox for startups, banks, funds, and regulators to innovate in digital finance and on-chain applications.

Model & Structure

  • Legal Sandbox:

    • Supports domestic and international enterprises establishing offices and launching digital asset/blockchain projects within the IFC.

    • Provides regulatory guidance and end-to-end licensing support.

  • International Partnership Ecosystem:

    • Builds a global network of Web3 and blockchain partners.

    • Encourages active participation and collaboration from international stakeholders to co-develop Vietnam’s fintech and on-chain markets.

  • R&D Center:

    • A collaborative research and development space for banks, funds, and tech firms.

    • Facilitates pilot projects, innovation labs, and applied use cases in digital finance and emerging technologies.

Mission
To establish the Fintech Hub at IFC Ho Chi Minh City as a strategic driver for Vietnam’s financial center ambitions, positioning the city as a global fintech and on-chain innovation hub.

Objectives

  • Attract capital flows by nurturing fintech startups, products, and new business models.

  • Increase IFC HCMC’s competitiveness through a connected digital finance ecosystem of startups, banks, global investors, and institutions.

  • Position Ho Chi Minh City as a regional leader in digital finance innovation across blockchain, AI, cross-border payments, and digital assets.

  • Strengthen international connectivity by linking with major global financial centers to attract capital, talent, and technology.

With The Vietnam House promoting outward visibility and Fintech Hub driving internal capability building, the On-chain Hub creates a holistic framework to both export Vietnam’s Web3 innovation and import global resources into Vietnam’s on-chain economy.
